dataset.description:
The DMP includes six categories of research data generated during the project.
1) Deliverables as per se research data: OpenMusE research data are illustrated in project deliverables, which include the research data collected and provided in each WP. 
Deliverables might include subcategories of research data considering some technical specifications:
a. Descriptive documents only, including table of contents, executive summary, paragraphs and references;
b. Live policy reports in the format of complex document (data visualisation text and code) and published on the website and made available on Zenodo and on the project website.
2) Scientific articles: these research data are related to scientific peer review publications, non-peer reviewed working papers, and discussion papers.
3) Primary research data collected by project partners: using survey questionnaires, opt-in data collection forms, and other instruments. Data will be collected from both natural persons and other data subjects, e.g., enterprises and organisations in the music sector. 
4) Statistical infrastructure to be developed in the project and based on the reuse and processing of 1) open-access data, and 2) data provided through voluntary industry cooperation. 
5)Open Music Observatory software to be developed following the Digital Music Observatory minimum viable product and creating rich documentation and various access modes for our data, currently under development
6) Communication and dissemination materials, including mailing lists, newsletters, social channels according to the given activities.
